responsibility: This file implements the public C API of libgccjit by wrapping the internal recording/playback C++ machinery. It defines the concrete opaque API structs as subclasses of recording or result classes, performs extensive API-boundary validation and error reporting, and forwards every gcc_jit_* entrypoint to the appropriate recording::context, block, type, function, or result operation, including newer features such as extended asm and reflection. It is the primary ABI-facing bridge between external C callers and the internal libgccjit object model.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/libgccjit.h, which only declares the stable public C ABI, and gcc/jit/docs/_build/texinfo/libgccjit.texi, which publishes documentation, this same-stem source file contains the executable implementation of the C entrypoints, validation macros, and forwarding logic into the internal recording/playback classes.
